description:
Scan staged changes for secrets before commit. Blocks the commit if any known pattern matches (AWS keys, Stripe live keys, JWTs, PEM blocks, GitHub tokens, Google API keys, generic high-entropy strings).
Trigger this skill when: - Before running `git commit` (auto). - User says "check for secrets", "scan for keys", or invokes `/secrets-check`. - Before staging any `.env*` or `credentials*` file.
